claim: A confocal frame taken with the spinning disk stopped is a stationary pinhole grid at full brightness, so brightness and contrast look normal and nothing seems wrong. The texture gives it away: on the difference of a lit and an unlit frame, the largest off-centre term of the power spectrum over its median is orders of magnitude higher with a stationary grid than with smooth illumination, and a frame with no signal stays low.
validity_conditions: Ruled TRANSFER, passed 10.3 rules 1 and 3: the observation and the method cross; the ratios, the grid period and the prior thresholds do not, because they sit in prose and a markdown table and because nobody here chose the thresholds (the microscope seat ruled them discard). Measured in another project on 2026-09-07 at 20x through both camera arms. Slot: A1 (artefacts) and O1 preflight -- the microscope already carries the method in its live checklist. Falsified by a stopped-disk frame whose spectrum is indistinguishable from a spinning one.
